info.name: Edure API
info.description:
Production-ready Edure backend covering Sign Up, Onboarding, Home, Explore, Course Detail, My Learnings, Degree, and Account & Settings.

**Setup**:
1. Import this collection and the `Edure (local)` environment.
2. Select that environment (top-right).
3. Run **Auth → Login** — `access_token` and `refresh_token` are captured automatically.
4. All other requests inherit Bearer auth from the collection.

Default env values target the local docker-compose stack at `http://localhost:8000` and the seeded demo user `demo@edure.local / DemoPass123!`.

item.description: Backend-led Google sign-in. Open the login URL in a browser — the callback is rendered as HTML and reveals the access/refresh tokens for testing.

request.description: Returns 307 → https://accounts.google.com/... Postman won't render Google's UI; right-click the request and 'Open in Browser' to actually consent.
